Third-party reference data, downloaded by `tools/fetch_third_party.sh` and not committed.

- `PSPLibDoc.xml` — PSP NID → function name database from https://github.com/pspdev/psplibdoc (GPL-2.0).
- `xbrz/` — xBRZ pixel-art upscaler by Zenju (GPL-3.0), as vendored in PPSSPP's `ext/xbrz`. Texture upscaling (`MKU_TEXSCALE`).
- `stb/` — `stb_image.h` / `stb_image_write.h` by Sean Barrett (public domain / MIT). PNG for texture dumps and replacement packs.
